en.headline: Body of 53-year-old woman found in waters off Lamma Power Station
en.dek: Firefighters recovered the woman after a report of a floating figure around 10am on Saturday; police classified the case as found body.
body: Police received a report at about 10am on Saturday that a human figure was seen floating in the waters off the Lamma Power Station. Firefighters arrived and brought a woman ashore, but she was certified dead after assessment by attending personnel.
Preliminary enquiries established that the deceased was a 53-year-old woman surnamed Zhang who was carrying a Mainland identity card. No note was recovered at the scene.
The cause of death will be determined by autopsy, and the circumstances leading to her entering the water remain under investigation. Police have classified the case as a found body.

zh.headline: 南丫島發電廠對開海面發現女屍 53歲內地女子不治
zh.dek: 警方周六上午約10時接報有人形物體漂浮海面，消防到場救起女子後證實死亡，案件列發現屍體。
body: 警方周六上午約10時接獲報告，指南丫島發電廠對開海面有人形物體漂浮。消防人員到場後將一名女子救上岸，經現場人員檢查後證實死亡。
初步調查顯示死者為53歲張姓女子，身上帶有內地身份證。現場並無發現遺書。
死因有待驗屍確定，她如何落水的情況仍在調查中。警方已將案件列為發現屍體。
